parts.text:
Research techniques for granular control in LLM prompts without switching modes. Approaches: (1) Instruction hierarchy — how to mark some instructions as absolute/overriding vs optional. (2) Probabilistic soft constraints. (3) Chain-of-thought with validation checkpoints. (4) Reflection/self-verification loops where the model checks strict parts and ignores soft parts. (5) Any existing frameworks for 'partial control' where the model knows which parts of the prompt are hard constraints vs guidelines. Search the web.
